data: Two different publisher-synchronized physical EPFL laboratory camera recordings; no synthetic tracks
citation: Fleuret et al., Multi-Camera People Tracking with a Probabilistic Occupancy Map, TPAMI 2008, DOI 10.1109/TPAMI.2007.1174
threshold_note: Low test threshold to exercise mechanics, not a validated room capacity or evidence of danger.

correlations.explanation: Connected camera zones; compatible aggregate event types; onset timestamps 2.4s apart; image-flow directions are not compared without a shared coordinate frame. Shared regional conditions are possible; no identity matching performed. Publisher-synchronized different physical cameras of the same area; no identities matched and no GPS proximity asserted.
